headline: A Newspaper Written Overnight, For One Reader

bullets.t: Preview: tomorrow's 10 real headlines from AI, creators, Dubai and markets will sit here.
Each bullet is one line, short enough to read in a glance.
Tap the widget to open the full newspaper page.
Bigger widgets (large size) show 7 bullets plus the radar box.
Front Page, AI Tools, Money Moves and Creator Economy lead each edition.
Every story ends with a 'What it means for you' line.
Money stories list fees, requirements and red flags.
Radar items are tagged Confirmed, Likely or Rumour.
The paper is written at 06:48 Dubai, every day.
This preview disappears when the first real edition lands.
